questions.stem: Which two pollutant gases are the main causes of acid rain?
questions.explanation: Acid rain is caused mainly by sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitrogen oxides (NOx). SO2 comes from burning fossil fuels containing sulfur and forms sulfuric acid (H2SO4) in the atmosphere. NOx comes from high-temperature combustion in engines and forms nitric acid (HNO3). Normal rain is already slightly acidic (pH 5.6) due to dissolved CO2.
